entities.name: Simun the Quiet
entities.description: Gifted but troubled wizard from an unknown plane, cast out from the Order of the Elements, who created the Strongbox.

entities.name: Order of the Elements
entities.description: Order that cast Simun out for his unnatural ideas.

entities.name: Strongbox
entities.description: Orb-shaped secure vessel Simun built, with a key, to safeguard his secrets.

events.summary: Cast out from the Order of the Elements, Simun retreats to a hidden laboratory in an ancient fortress for over fifty years.
events.quote: After being cast out from the Order of the Elements due to his so-called "unnatural ideas,"

events.summary: Fearing his former comrades, Simun crafts the Strongbox and a key, hiding the key beyond discovery.
events.quote: This artifact, which he named the Strongbox

events.summary: Hearing tapping at his wall, Simun transfers all his secrets and memories into the Strongbox and locks it, then forgets what it is.
events.quote: Simun hastily transferred all of his accumulated secrets and memories into the Strongbox

relations.quote: Simun crafted a secure vessel to safeguard his secrets.
